root_cause.text: The delayed work item dev3_register_work can be scheduled after flush_workqueue() in psmouse_disconnect() but before the private data (priv) is freed in alps_disconnect(), resulting in a use-after-free when the work callback accesses the freed structure.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `disable_delayed_work_sync(&priv->dev3_register_work)` in `alps_disconnect()` to cancel the work before freeing priv. The CVE description and commit message explain the race: CPU 0 calls flush_workqueue() which only waits for already queued work; then CPU 1 can queue a new work item via `psmouse_queue_work()` after the flush but before `alps_disconnect()` frees priv, leading to the use-after-free.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix a potential race condition in alps_disconnect by cancelling dev3_register_work before tearing down devices.
intent_record.what: Added a call to disable_delayed_work_sync for priv->dev3_register_work before the cleanup checks for priv->dev2 and priv->dev3 in the alps_disconnect function.
intent_record.how: Ensures any pending delayed work for registering dev3 is cancelled synchronously before the driver disconnects, preventing concurrent access to freed resources.
